acquisition_method.evidence: The Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 480 was set to use the TopSpeed method with MS acquisition in the orbitrap with a resolution of 120,000 resolution and a mass range of 400–1500.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: After washing, samples were alkylated with 0.05 M iodoacetamide by mixing for 1 min and then left to stand in darkness for 20 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: After washing, samples were alkylated with 0.05 M iodoacetamide by mixing for 1 min and then left to stand in darkness for 20 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Digestion was performed using Trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega, Madison, WI, USA, catalog nr. V5073) in 0.05 M AmBiC for 18 h at 37 °C in a water bath.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Fragmentation was performed in an orbitrap with a resolution of 15,000 using HCD fragmentation and a 2 s time frame for fragmentation between MS scans.

ionization_type.evidence: subjected to MS analysis on a Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 480 instrument (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany) equipped with the Easy-Spray ion source (Thermo Scientific, Malakka, Malaysia).

labeling.evidence: Precursor Ion Quantifier was used to calculate label-free quantification from unique peptides, considering protein groups and using shared quantification results.
